76836-the-common-sense-of-sex.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The first vague sexual act is suckling. The child not only experiences the pleasure of food, but also of an act that has rhythm in it, the rhythm of the mouth working with the nipple. arxiv-2011-13947.title: The impact of magnetic fields on cosmological galaxy mergers. I: Reshaping gas and stellar discs 2020 The impact of magnetic fields on cosmological galaxy mergers. I: Reshaping gas and stellar discs – 18
arxiv-2011-13947.creator: Joseph Whittingham, Martin Sparre, Christoph Pfrommer, Rüdiger Pakmor
arxiv-2011-13947.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Joseph Whittingham, Martin Sparre, Christoph Pfrommer, Rüdiger Pakmor. Mergers play an important role in galaxy evolution. In particular, major mergers are able to have a transformative effect on galaxy morphology. In this paper, we investigate the role of magnetic fields in gas-rich major mergers. To this end, we run a series of high-resolution magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) zoom-in simulations with the moving-mesh code arepo and compare the outcome with hydrodynamic simulations run from the same initial conditions.

arxiv-2112-11385.title: Orbit determination methods for interplanetary missions: development and use of the Orbit14 software Journal: Experimental Astronomy
arxiv-2112-11385.creator: Giacomo Lari 1 ∗, Giulia Schettino 1 2, Daniele Serra 1, Giacomo Tommei 1
arxiv-2112-11385.description: Abstract In the last years, a new generation of interplanetary space missions have been designed for the exploration of the solar system. At the same time, radio-science instrumentation has reached an unprecedented level of accuracy, leading to a significant improvement of our knowledge of celestial bodies. Along with this hardware upgrade, software products for interplanetary missions have been greatly refined.

arxiv-2205-10161.title: The role of the Big Geographic Sort in the circulation of misinformation among U.S. Reddit users
arxiv-2205-10161.creator: Lia Bozarth, Daniele Quercia, Licia Capra, Sanja Scepanovic
arxiv-2205-10161.description: Abstract Past research has attributed the online circulation of misinformation to two main factors - individual characteristics (e.g., a person’s information literacy) and social media effects (e.g., algorithm-mediated information diffusion) - and has overlooked a third one: the critical mass created by the offline self-segregation of Americans into like-minded geographical regions such as states (a phenomenon called ‘The Big Sort’).

arxiv-2305-15105.title: On the stability and deformability of top stars
arxiv-2305-15105.creator: Massimo Bianchi, Giorgio Di Russo, Alfredo Grillo, Jose Francisco Morales, Giuseppe Sudano
arxiv-2305-15105.description: Abstract Topological stars, or top stars for brevity, are smooth horizonless static solutions of Einstein-Maxwell theory in 5-d that reduce to spherically symmetric solutions of Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton theory in 4-d. We study linear scalar perturbations of top stars and argue for their stability and deformability.

arxiv-2408-04682.title: ToolSandbox : A Stateful, Conversational, Interactive Evaluation Benchmark for LLM Tool Use Capabilities
arxiv-2408-04682.creator: Jiarui Lu, Thomas Holleis, Yizhe Zhang, Bernhard Aumayer
arxiv-2408-04682.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiarui Lu, Thomas Holleis, Yizhe Zhang, Bernhard Aumayer. Recent large language models (LLMs) advancements sparked a growing research interest in tool assisted LLMs solving real-world challenges, which calls for comprehensive evaluation of tool-use capabilities.

arxiv-2503-08965.title: LLM-Driven Usefulness Labeling for IR Evaluation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Information systems Information retrieval Evaluation of retrieval results Retrieval efficiency
arxiv-2503-08965.creator: Mouly Dewan, Jiqun Liu, Chirag Shah
arxiv-2503-08965.description: Abstract . In the information retrieval (IR) domain, evaluation plays a crucial role in optimizing search experiences and supporting diverse user intents. In the recent LLM era, research has been conducted to automate document relevance labels, as these labels have traditionally been assigned by crowd-sourced workers - a process that is both time and consuming and costly.

arxiv-2508-17724.title: Adhesion Control through Electric Field-Induced Water Adsorption at Oxidized Silicon Interfaces
arxiv-2508-17724.creator: H. Tunç Çiftçi, Jonathon Cottom, Rachid Hahury, Emilia Olsson, Bart Weber
arxiv-2508-17724.description: Abstract Adhesion plays a pivotal role in computer chip manufacturing, directly affecting the precision and durability of positioning components such as wafer stages. Electrical biasing is widely employed to eliminate floating potential and to enable electrostatic clamping. However, upon electrical grounding adhesion can persist and there is limited knowledge about the nature of this adhesion hysteresis.

arxiv-2511-19690.title: The Buffer Minimization Problem for Scheduling Flow Jobs with Conflicts
arxiv-2511-19690.creator: Niklas Haas, Sören Schmitt, Rob van Stee
arxiv-2511-19690.description: Abstract We consider the online buffer minimization in multiprocessor systems with conflicts problem (in short, the buffer minimization problem ) in the recently introduced flow model. In an online fashion, workloads arrive on some of the n n processors and are stored in an input buffer.

arxiv-2511-20687.title: Hybrid coupling with operator inference and the overlapping Schwarz alternating method
arxiv-2511-20687.creator: Irina Tezaur, Eric Parish, Anthony Gruber, Ian Moore, Christopher Wentland, Alejandro Mota
arxiv-2511-20687.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Irina Tezaur, Eric Parish, Anthony Gruber, Ian Moore, Christopher Wentland, Alejandro Mota. This paper presents a novel hybrid approach for coupling subdomain-local non-intrusive Operator Inference (OpInf) reduced order models (ROMs) with each other and with subdomain-local high-fidelity full order models (FOMs) with using the overlapping Schwarz alternating method (O-SAM). The proposed methodology addresses significant challenges in multiscale modeling and simulation, particularly the long runtime and complex mesh generation requirements associated with traditional high-fidelity simulations.

arxiv-2511-21415.title: DiverseVAR: Balancing Diversity and Quality of Next-Scale Visual Autoregressive Models
arxiv-2511-21415.creator: Mingue Park Prin Phunyaphibarn Phillip Y. Lee Minhyuk Sung
arxiv-2511-21415.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mingue Park Prin Phunyaphibarn Phillip Y. Lee Minhyuk Sung. We introduce DiverseVAR , a framework that enhances the diversity of text-conditioned visual autoregressive models (VAR) at test time without requiring retraining, fine-tuning, or substantial computational overhead. While VAR models have recently emerged as strong competitors to diffusion and flow models for image generation, they suffer from a critical limitation in diversity, often producing nearly identical images even for simple prompts. This issue has largely gone unnoticed amid the predominant focus on image quality.

pmc-10736707.title: RURAL–URBAN DIFFERENCES IN POSTSURGICAL SERVICE USE AND OUTCOMES AMONG VETERANS WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-10736707.creator: Heather Davila, Yubo Gao, Michael Jacobs, Katherine Hadlandsmyth, Carly Duncan, Andrea Strayer, Daniel Hall, Mary Vaughan-Sarrazin
pmc-10736707.description: Adults with dementia have worse post-surgical outcomes than those without dementia, including readmission and death. The use of home health or facility-based skilled nursing after discharge may prevent poor outcomes. We know little about rural-urban differences in post-discharge services or outcomes among individuals with dementia.

Methods: The complex sample design analysis using SPSS 20.0 revealed the following.

pmc-11590335.title: Association of prognostic nutritional index with the presence and all-cause mortality of rheumatoid arthritis: the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2003–2018
pmc-11590335.creator: Junjie Wang, Rui Zhu, Haonan Fang, Xing Xing, Liru Ge, Guoqi Cai
pmc-11590335.description: BackgroundThe prognostic nutritional index (PNI) is a comprehensive measure of individual immune and nutritional status. This study aimed to evaluate the role of PNI in the presence and mortality of rheumatoid arthritis (RA).MethodsThis study used data of participants aged ≥ 40 years from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2003–2018.

pmc-11644937.title: Enhanced Conditional GAN for High-Quality Synthetic Tabular Data Generation in Mobile-Based Cardiovascular Healthcare
pmc-11644937.creator: Malak Alqulaity, Po Yang
pmc-11644937.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The generation of synthetic tabular data has emerged as a critical task in various fields, particularly in healthcare, where data privacy concerns limit the availability of real datasets for research and analysis. This paper presents an enhanced Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) architecture designed for generating high-quality synthetic tabular data, with a focus on cardiovascular disease datasets that encompass mixed data types and complex feature relationships.

pmc-12512608.title: Determinants of early initiation of breastfeeding in Côte d’Ivoire: a hospital-based study
pmc-12512608.creator: Kouakou Kouamé Cyprien, Djivohessoun Augustine, Djoman Isabelle, Folquet Amorissani
pmc-12512608.description: BackgroundEarly initiation of breastfeeding (EIBF), defined as putting the newborn to the breast within the first hour of life, is a cost-effective and evidence-based intervention to reduce neonatal morbidity and mortality. In Côte d’Ivoire, EIBF coverage remains suboptimal despite international recommendations.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional analytical study from June to July 2022 at Abobo Houphouët-Boigny Regional Hospital in Abidjan.

pmc-12605995.title: Radiofrequency Ablation for Focal Atrial Tachycardia Originating From the Fossa Ovalis: Experiences and Outcomes
pmc-12605995.creator: Mingxian Chen, Xuping Li, Zhuo Wang, Jiantong Zhu, Min Zhong, Qiming Liu, Shenghua Zhou
pmc-12605995.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the electrocardiographic characteristics, electrophysiological features, and outcomes of radiofrequency ablation in patients with focal atrial tachycardia (FAT) originating from the fossa ovalis (FO).MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 67 patients with FAT originating from the FO and classified into two groups: the Unilateral Ablation Group (n = 36) and the Bilateral Ablation Group (n = 31).

pmc-13146608.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A674 NET CLINICAL BENEFIT OF STARTING ANTICOAGULATION EARLY AFTER ISCHEMIC STROKE IN ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: A META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED TRIALS FROM THE CATALYST COLLABORATION
pmc-13146608.creator: Alexandros Polymeris, Konstantina Chalkou, Georgia Salanti, Hakim-Moulay Dehbi, Jonas Oldgren, Truman Milling, Steven Warach, Signild Åsberg, David Werring, Urs Fischer
pmc-13146608.description: Background and aimsStarting direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) early after atrial fibrillation(AF)-associated ischaemic stroke reduces the composite of subsequent ischaemic or haemorrhagic stroke. However, whether early treatment confers net clinical benefit (NCB) after accounting for the different clinical importance of ischaemic and haemorrhagic events is unclear.MethodsPrespecified analysis of CATALYST pooling individual participant data from four trials (ELAN, OPTIMAS, START, TIMING).

pmc-13568279.title: Comparative Analysis of Support Vector Machine Variants for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensor Data
pmc-13568279.creator: Minh Long Hoang
pmc-13568279.description: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using wearable sensor data is widely applied in healthcare, smart environments, and mobile systems. Support Vector Machines (SVMs) are commonly used for HAR due to their strong generalization ability. However, traditional approaches often rely on single kernels and may not fully capture complex motion patterns.

pmc-13619087.creator: Dirk A. Pevernagie, Marie De Bruecker, Elke Veirman, Geert Crombez, Dimitri M. L. Van Ryckeghem, Katrien Hertegonne, Fré A. Bauters, Inger L. Abma, Erna Sif Arnardottir, Ludger Grote, Jan Hedner, Anna Sigridur. Islind, Kamilla Rún Jóhannsdóttir, Gert Jan Lammers, Walter T. McNicholas, Piet‐Heijn van
pmc-13619087.description: Sleep medicine relies on patient‐reported outcome measures (PROMs) to complement clinical interviews and objective sleep tests. Available sleep questionnaires focus on isolated symptoms or single disorders, limiting their ability to capture the complexity of sleep conditions. Also, many PROMs remain poorly validated.
